statement: Linux hid-playstation registers the DualSense lightbar as one multicolor LED class device named '<input>:rgb:indicator' with red, green and blue sub-LEDs, and five white player LEDs (player1-player5, max brightness 1). It registers no LED class device for the mic-mute LED: the driver toggles the mute LED and the hardware mic mute itself on each mute-button press.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 871-905 (multicolor lightbar), 1222-1245 (player LED get/set), 1405-1430 (mute LED plus power-save mic mute), 1510-1525 (button toggle), 1744-1755 (player LED info). Kernel consumer behaviour only.
